title: Vortex Orb Alien Shop
description: A mystical wooden door set in a stone wall features a large glowing green alien floating inside a cosmic orb containing planets and stars. To the right, a wooden shelf holds potion bottles, old keys, a lit candle, and a sign advertising 'Cosmic Green Alien Vortex freshly harvested from the Rippling Veil'.
prompt: A glowing green alien floats inside a transparent cosmic orb filled with planets and stars, hanging on an old wooden door with 'VORTEX ORB SPELLS EST. 0233' written on it. The door is set in a dark stone wall with constellation paintings above. To the right, a wooden windowsill displays glowing potion bottles, antique keys, a lit candle, and a sign reading 'Cosmic Green Alien Vortex Freshly Harvested from the Rippling Veil', in a whimsical fantasy style.
